title: Sharpened by the Gods
blurb: A duel of half-answers across Circe's table. The price of the truth: his dagger.

characters.name: Circe
characters.description: The sorceress of Aiaia. Sharp-eyed, amused, dangerous.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Starving, armed, and lying about who he is.

lines.direction: Let the pause hang. Look away, then back.

lines.text: Would they tell you where I could find my men?
lines.direction: Your voice cracks a little. You need this.
Almost begging. Hands open on the table.
Hold out your hand, palm up. Wait for the dagger.

lines.text: If you give me your dagger.
lines.direction: Hold out your hand, palm up. Wait for the dagger.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
